pins.name: GPIO2
pins.label: GPIO2
pins.notes:
PIN_CARD_DETECT — onboard SD card connector's card-presence-detect switch (Carrier XL hardware; see board-level note). digital_output/pwm_output dropped: it's a mechanical switch to GND, so driving this pin as an output could short against the switch when a card is inserted. digital_input retained since reading card presence is a genuine, safe, useful operation. Former PIN_WIRE1_SDA alias on this same GPIO removed from pins_arduino.h as an unused/vestigial default (see bug-fix note above) so it doesn't also pick up a spurious i2c_sda capability.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D3
pins.label: GPIO3 (Led active low)
pins.notes: PIN_LED / LED_USR — onboard user LED on the Carrier XL breakout (D2, red, Device:D_Small) that this Stamp module plugs/solders into. Confirmed via the Carrier XL's own official KiCad schematic (github.com/solderparty/rp2xxx_stamp_carrier_xl_hw): GPIO-row/alt-name pairing method (cross-validated against 19 other already-known pin roles on the same connector listing) places "LED_USR" at the same row as "GPIO3"; net-trace of the LED circuit (+3.3V -> R10 1K -> D2 anode -> D2 cathode -> JP2 bridged jumper -> GPIO3) confirms active-low (GPIO3 must sink current to light it). digital_input dropped per this repo's established led_high/led_low precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2350 GPIO. Former PIN_WIRE1_SCL alias on this same GPIO removed from pins_arduino.h (see bug-fix note above) so it doesn't also pick up a spurious i2c_scl capability. Not confirmed present on the bare Stamp module by itself (its own KiCad schematic shows no LED on this net) — see board-level CAVEAT.

pins.name: D6
pins.label: GPIO6 (Button)
pins.notes: BTN_USR1 — onboard user pushbutton on the Carrier XL breakout (SW4, Switch:SW_SPST, TS-3025-A-A-B), in the same momentary-to-GND switch ladder as the board's own RESET (SW1) and BOOTSEL (SW2) buttons. Not aliased in this board's pins_arduino.h (no PIN_BUTTON define shipped by arduino-pico for this board) — added directly as a chipGpios entry, matching this repo's adafruit_itsybitsy GPIO13 BOOT-button precedent for an unaliased-but-confirmed button pin. Confirmed via the Carrier XL's own official KiCad schematic using the same GPIO-row/alt-name pairing method as GPIO3 above ("BTN_USR1" label at the same row as "GPIO6"). Active-low with the RP2350's internal pull-up assumed by convention (matches this repo's standard button-tag precedent) — not independently confirmed via a devicetree/firmware source. Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin). Not confirmed present on the bare Stamp module by itself — see board-level CAVEAT.
